DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN,  -- distruibuite data eventualy across nodes 
HEAP

CREATE TABLE we48schema.bank_txn_hash
(
    txnid int,
    txndate date,
    custid VARCHAR(50),
    amt FLOAT,
    branch VARCHAR(50),
    region VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
DISTRIBUTION=HASH(region),  -- distruibuite data based on region 
CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX -- columnar data format - like parquet 
);





CREATE TABLE we48schema.bank_txn_rpl

    txnid int,

    custid VARCHAR(50),
    amt FLOAT,
    branch VARCHAR(50),
    region VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
DISTRIBUTION=REPLICATE,  -- small table for join and lookup (broadcast spark option)
CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX -- columnar data format - like parquet 
);
